subject.title: [Bug]: Install bug:No matching version found for node-domexception@1.0.28

question: Should the final `node-domexception` resolver change be carried as a maintainer-owned dependency update, or should maintainers repair and authorize the open external PR?
rationale: The remaining fix changes root dependency resolution and package-manager artifacts, which repository policy treats as dependency/security-sensitive and not safe for an automatic issue repair lane while a linked PR is open.

options.title: Maintainer-owned dependency update
options.body: A maintainer applies the chosen resolver strategy internally, regenerates artifacts, and provides install/build proof plus dependency approval.

options.title: Repair the open linked PR
options.body: Maintainership can keep https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95960 as the candidate if its dependency target and generated artifacts are corrected and authorized.

options.title: Close candidates and redesign
options.body: If neither current target is acceptable, close the candidate PRs and keep this issue open for a narrower dependency strategy.

recommendation.title: Maintainer-owned dependency update
recommendation.body: A maintainer applies the chosen resolver strategy internally, regenerates artifacts, and provides install/build proof plus dependency approval.

likelyOwner.reason: The alias override and guardrail history points most strongly to vincentkoc as the best routing candidate for the dependency policy decision.
